title: Lunkenheimer Lot Skatepark
subtitle: Redevelopment suggestion
summary: A redevelopment suggestion for the vacant Lunkenheimer lot — a skatepark plaza with planted edges, a covered stage, and terraced seating, developed in plan and digital terrain models. [CONFIRM details]

sections.heading: Suggestion
sections.body: [CONFIRM] An underused industrial lot reimagined as a neighborhood skatepark: bowl, ledges, and banks set in a planted plaza, tested through a stylized plan and laser-cut-style digital terrain models.
